faqs.q: Who can use Amazon DSP?
faqs.a: The platform is not limited to Amazon sellers. Brands, agencies, and software or service providers can also advertise through DSP. Some audience capabilities become available only when Amazon commerce data exists for the advertiser.

faqs.q: How does Amazon DSP targeting work?
faqs.a: We build targeting from the audience and intent signals that fit the campaign. Those can include Amazon Audiences, advertiser data, third-party segments, contextual signals, products, categories, keywords, in-market audiences, and remarketing pools.

faqs.q: How much should I budget for Amazon DSP advertising?
faqs.a: Amazon’s managed-service option typically carries a $50,000 minimum spend, which can vary by country. That figure does not define every Amazon DSP engagement. We set the working Amazon DSP budget around marketplace, objective, audience, format, and testing scope.

faqs.q: Can an Amazon DSP campaign support multiple hero products?
faqs.a: Amazon DSP can support multiple products within one plan. Responsive eCommerce Creative allows up to 20 ASINs per creative. We separate campaigns or ad groups when products have different objectives, economics, audience strategies, or reporting needs.

faqs.q: How current is Amazon DSP reporting?
faqs.a: Amazon DSP reporting refreshes several times each day rather than continuously. Most impressions, clicks, and conversion metrics update every three to six hours. Other metrics generally refresh at least every 12 hours, depending on the report.

faqs.q: Can Amazon DSP target around competitor products?
faqs.a: Eligible product targeting can use specific products and related shopping signals, including products people viewed or searched for. We use those signals at product or category level rather than treating them as access to another brand’s customer records.

faqs.q: Can RA Tech take over existing Amazon DSP campaigns?
faqs.a: Existing Amazon DSP campaigns can be audited before any restructure. We review campaign and ad-group structure, targeting, bids, budgets, pacing, frequency, creatives, conversion setup, and reporting history before deciding what should remain, change, or stop.

faqs.q: How do I get started with an Amazon DSP agency like RA Tech?
faqs.a: Start with one defined Amazon DSP problem or objective. RA Tech reviews the account context, existing campaign activity, products, audience options, creative readiness, and budget range, then sets out the scope and recommended next step before further commitment.

faqs.q: Do I need Seller Central or Vendor Central to use Amazon DSP?
faqs.a: You can run Amazon DSP without holding a Seller Central or Vendor Central account. The platform also serves advertisers whose products are not sold on Amazon. Retail-specific audience options are the exception, since some of those depend on Amazon purchase or product-view activity.

faqs.q: What information do you need to start Amazon DSP management?
faqs.a: The first step is understanding what you want the campaign to do. From there, we look at marketplace, products or offers, budget, creative readiness, existing media activity, and any DSP history already in the account. Available first-party audience data can also shape the setup.

faqs.q: What creative assets are needed for Amazon DSP?
faqs.a: Creative requirements depend on what is being served. Static display may call for layered design files, imagery, logos, brand assets, copy, fonts, and the final landing destination. Video requires a compliant video file prepared to Amazon’s technical rules.

services/full-listing-optimization.title: Amazon Product Listing Services Built Around One Complete Product Detail Page (PDP)
intro: Every section of an Amazon product page competes for limited shopper attention. Repeated information wastes that space and leaves useful questions unanswered.

Our Amazon product listing services give copy, images, A+ Content, structured data, and supplied media a defined role. As an Amazon product listing agency, RA Tech coordinates the work from first audit through publication.

sections.title: Audit the PDP Before Any Rebuild
body: A full rebuild should start with a clear record of what already exists. The first review documents the current page without deciding the final strategy. Our Amazon PDP optimization audit records the condition of major PDP elements and the catalog setup behind them.
The review is grouped around five current-state checks:

cards.title: Existing Content
body: The audit records the live Item Name, bullets, description, images, enhanced content, and available media across the current ASIN.

cards.title: Asset Condition
body: Each asset is recorded as current, outdated, incomplete, unavailable, or technically unsuitable.

cards.title: Catalog Setup
body: Product attributes, variation structure, category requirements, and known catalog issues are documented before planning begins.

cards.title: Marketplace Readiness
body: Available inputs are recorded alongside any access, content, or catalog limitations visible at the audit stage.

cards.title: Starting Position
body: The review closes with a documented baseline for the agreed project scope.

after: This gives Amazon full listing optimization a factual baseline before strategic decisions begin.

sections.title: Build the Product and Buyer Evidence Base
body: The next stage gathers the evidence production teams will use. Search data alone cannot define the whole PDP. Our Amazon product listing services can draw from product documentation, available account data, category context, and customer language.
Each source adds a different type of evidence to the project:

cards.title: Product documentation
body: Verified specifications, approved claims, and use details

cards.title: Search evidence
body: Relevant query demand and shopper terminology

cards.title: Category context
body: Common content expectations and market language

cards.title: Customer language
body: Wording customers use across reviews, support, and search

cards.title: Existing PDP data
body: Live wording, current assets, and historical context

after: An Amazon SEO agency may start with search demand. End-to-end planning also needs product proof and buyer context.

sections.title: Give Every PDP Message One Owner
body: Once the evidence is settled, each information type needs one primary home across the PDP. Our Amazon product detail page optimization structure assigns content according to the role each surface performs.
The seven areas below keep information placement clear before production begins:

cards.title: Product Identity
body: Item Name and Item Highlights carry the product name, defining information, and important details that need early visibility.

cards.title: Immediate Buyer Detail
body: Bullets and upper PDP content handle the practical facts shoppers need soon after opening the product page.

cards.title: Visual Product Proof
body: The main image and secondary image stack show scale, use, comparison, dimensions, and other details that benefit from visual explanation.

cards.title: Structured Product Facts
body: Attributes and variation data hold product information that Amazon uses across catalog fields and product relationships.

cards.title: Deeper Product Education
body: A+ Content gives the product more room for comparison, explanation, supporting detail, and information that does not fit comfortably above.

cards.title: Brand-Level Context
body: Brand Story carries company background, brand positioning, and wider catalog context without taking space from product-focused information.

cards.title: Motion-Based Explanation
body: Video can support assembly, operation, movement, application, or other product details when motion makes the explanation clearer.

after: Detailed field execution can move into Amazon listing optimization services when the searchable listing needs specialist work. The same structure keeps Amazon product page optimization focused on deliberate information placement across the PDP.

sections.title: Build a New Listing or Rework an Existing PDP

cards.title: New Product Listing

sections.title: Keep Production Teams Aligned
body: End-to-end work depends on clean coordination between research, copy, design, and publishing. Production can drift when separate teams use different working files. Our Amazon product listing services use controlled source material and approval points throughout production.
The following checkpoints keep the work aligned before final files move forward:

cards.title: Approved Source File
body: One controlled file records approvals, owners, revision dates, and the current version after research closes.

cards.title: Copy Lock Timing
body: Core product language is approved before the final creative brief is locked. Designers then work from settled wording and approved claims.

cards.title: Shared Creative Brief
body: Visual teams receive the locked creative brief, assigned asset priorities, and the latest approved copy references. Detailed execution can move into Amazon listing image design services when a dedicated gallery build forms part of the project.

cards.title: Enhanced Content Handoff
body: Deeper product education moves into the A+ brief after upper-PDP content has been approved. Specialist production can move into Amazon A+ Content design services when enhanced content forms part of the scope.

cards.title: Version Control Check
body: File names, revision status, and approval markers are checked before publishing receives the final production set.

after: An Amazon creative agency can produce strong individual assets. Coordinated production also needs disciplined control between teams.

sections.title: Remove Repetition Across the PDP
body: A complete page can feel thin when the same claim appears across several surfaces. Repeated content also takes space from other buyer concerns. Our Amazon listing content services include a cross-asset duplication pass before final approval.
The review separates three different uses of information across the PDP:

cards.title: State the Fact
body: Keep the core product fact in the clearest text location, where shoppers can understand it quickly without searching across several assets.

cards.title: Add Visual Proof
body: Use images when scale, comparison, application, dimensions, or product detail becomes easier to understand visually.

cards.title: Expand Where Needed
body: Use deeper content only when the buyer needs added explanation, supporting detail, or a clearer comparison before making a decision. Repeated information stays only when the second appearance adds new proof, context, or decision value.

sections.title: Cover the Buyer Questions Still Missing
body: Once repeated content is removed, unanswered buyer questions become easier to identify. Our Amazon product page optimization review checks if the PDP gives buyers enough detail to evaluate the offer.
Five areas cover common information gaps.

cards.title: Fit and Compatibility
body: Supported models, sizes, devices, or use conditions should be clear before purchase.

cards.title: Size and Specifications
body: Dimensions, capacity, materials, quantity, and technical details need accurate placement across the relevant PDP surfaces.

cards.title: Use and Setup
body: Products with assembly, preparation, installation, or operating steps may need clear guidance before purchase.

cards.title: Included Components
body: Bundles, accessories, pack contents, and supplied parts should match the actual offer.

cards.title: Product Differences
body: Related models and variations need enough separation to reduce confusion during selection.

sections.title: Take the Approved Assets Live
body: Production is complete only when approved materials reach the PDP correctly. Publishing can introduce missing content, wrong ordering, or display changes.
An Amazon listing agency should define the implementation boundary before publishing begins.
The live-page check focuses only on publication accuracy.
* Approved copy should appear in the intended fields and sequence.
* Image order should match the final gallery structure.
* Enhanced content should display in the approved format when included.
* Supplied media should appear in the planned location when supported.
* Variation information should remain accurate after publication.
* Rejected or altered content should be recorded for correction.
Live QA confirms that approved Amazon product listing services work reached the product page correctly.

sections.title: Prepare the PDP for Measured Refinement
body: A published PDP can create new evidence for future decisions. Eligible brands may later test selected content through Amazon experimentation tools. Testing should compare meaningful alternatives linked to a specific performance question.
* Each test should begin with a defined reason.
* Eligible content should meet platform requirements before launch.
* Final decisions should use available experiment data.
An Amazon optimization agency can support this stage when testing belongs inside the agreed engagement.

services/listing-optimization.title: Amazon Listing Optimization Services Built for the Way Amazon Works Today
intro: Amazon gives sellers limited space to explain a product, and every field carries a separate job. Weak field use can waste strong product information before a shopper reaches the page.

Our Amazon listing optimization services start with search behavior, product facts, catalog data, and current field structure. RA Tech uses those inputs to decide what belongs where before the copy is rewritten.

sections.title: Find the Gaps Before Rewriting the Listing
body: A listing can look complete and still leave useful information scattered across weak locations. Search terms may repeat, specifications may disappear, and variation details may lack a clear home.
Our Amazon listing audit starts with the live page and checks the gaps behind the visible copy. The findings shape the rewrite instead of forcing a standard template onto every ASIN.
Five areas receive attention before new copy is planned.

cards.title: Field use
body: The audit should catch repetition before adding anything new. A phrase used in the Item Name does not automatically need another appearance in Item Highlights, bullets, description, and generic terms.

cards.title: Product facts
body: Buyer-facing detail comes next. Missing dimensions, unclear material, unstated capacity, compatibility gaps, or omitted approved claims can all weaken the page.

cards.title: Search coverage
body: Existing search terms are compared with relevant query language to see where coverage is genuinely thin.

cards.title: Structured data
body: Product attributes are checked separately because an empty structured field can affect filtering even when the copy itself looks fine.

cards.title: Variation accuracy
body: Parent-child placement is reviewed so shared information stays shared and variation-specific detail does not end up in the wrong place.

after: A search-result problem may come from the primary image instead of written content. Those cases can move into Amazon main image optimization services under a separate scope.
The audit gives Amazon product listing optimization a factual starting point. New copy then responds to the actual page.

sections.title: Identify the Queries That Deserve Listing Space
body: Keyword work starts with product relevance before demand enters the discussion. Search volume has little value when the term stretches product meaning.

Our Amazon keyword optimization process combines product facts with available search data. Research can include Brand Analytics, category language, competing ASINs, customer wording, and approved use cases.
Each signal answers a different question before a term receives listing space.

cards.title: Search relevance
body: The query accurately describes the product or a genuine use case.

cards.title: Query activity
body: Customers actively use the term during Amazon searches.

cards.title: Funnel behavior
body: Available data can reveal impressions, clicks, cart activity, and purchases.

cards.title: Product support
body: Approved product facts support the search intent clearly.

cards.title: Existing coverage
body: The listing already carries the concept or leaves a useful gap.

after: A capable Amazon SEO agency should make these decisions before drafting begins. Strong Amazon SEO listing optimization depends on useful terms, clear product fit, and disciplined placement. Our Amazon listing SEO services keep the keyword plan tied to the product itself.

sections.title: What Our Team Optimizes on an Amazon Listing
body: The service covers visible copy, hidden search inputs, and structured product information. Each area receives separate attention because its role inside the listing is different.
The work is divided across five listing components.

cards.title: Item Name and Item Highlights
body: Our Amazon product title optimization work starts with product identity. Strong defining information receives priority inside the shorter Item Name structure. Item Highlights can carry secondary specifications, material, use cases, or compatibility detail. The wording extends the title without copying it.

cards.title: Bullet Points for Buyer Decisions
body: Amazon bullet point optimization focuses on the questions buyers need answered before purchase. Specifications, capacity, compatibility, dimensions, materials, and use context belong here when relevant. Each bullet receives one information owner. Keyword placement follows the product detail and keeps the sentence clear.

cards.title: Product Description for Supporting Context
body: The description carries useful context when the field remains relevant. It can expand information that deserves more room than a bullet provides. Deep visual education belongs inside a separate A+ Content project.

cards.title: Generic Search Terms for Hidden Coverage
body: Visible copy does not need to carry every useful search phrase. Amazon backend search terms can hold relevant synonyms, abbreviations, alternate product names, and other language shoppers may actually use. Space is limited, so repeated words do little. Competitor names, weak associations, and unsupported phrases should be cut before the field is finalized.

cards.title: Product Attributes for Structured Data
body: Structured fields carry product facts in a format Amazon can use across the catalog. These may include size, material, dimensions, compatibility, capacity, unit count, and other category-specific values. Our Amazon product listing optimization services review the attributes and the copy together so both tell the same product story.

sections.title: Build Search Coverage Without Writing for a Keyword Counter
body: Keyword placement should support the listing and preserve natural product language. Every useful term needs a clear reason for appearing in a visible or hidden field.
Our Amazon listing optimization services map keywords against relevance, buyer value, and field purpose. The plan separates core terms from supporting language before drafting begins.
Following four placement decisions keep that process practical:

cards.title: Core category terms
body: These belong where product identity and search meaning are strongest. Their placement should never weaken the sentence around them.

cards.title: Useful supporting terms
body: These work best beside a product fact that gives the wording clear context. Search demand alone does not decide the location.

cards.title: Legitimate synonyms and alternate names
body: These can move into visible copy or generic terms according to clarity. Their role depends on how shoppers describe the product.

cards.title: Weak or unsupported terms
body: These are removed before final drafting begins. Extra search volume does not justify a poor product match.

after: This structure keeps Amazon search optimization focused on useful coverage and clean product language. Repetitive phrasing drops away because each term has a defined purpose.

sections.title: When a Listing Needs Fresh Optimization
body: A product page can age even when the core product remains unchanged. Search behavior, catalog data, field rules, and customer questions can change around it.
A fresh review makes sense when a real change creates a new information gap. The trigger should come from the listing, product, or available search data.
Several situations deserve another pass.
* Amazon changes content rules or field requirements for the category.
* Product specifications, packaging, included items, or approved claims change.
* New sizes, colors, bundles, or model variations join the listing.
* Search data reveals new relevant queries or weakening coverage.
* Customer questions expose missing specifications or unclear product detail.
* The listing follows an older title or field structure.
A fresh Amazon product listing optimization review can focus on those changed inputs. The work then responds to a current problem with a defined scope.

sections.title: How RA Tech Handles Amazon Listing Optimization

body: Main-image optimization only works when the creative idea still stays within Amazon’s image rules. Before any alternate concept moves forward, the image needs a proper compliance check.

cards.title: Background
body: Standard main images use a pure white background, generally RGB 255, 255, 255. The setting should remain clean, with no added scenery or decorative treatment.

cards.title: Frame occupancy
body: Amazon expects the product to fill at least 85% of the image area. Stronger framing can improve visibility without cutting away important product detail.

cards.title: Product accuracy
body: The image must match the actual offer. Quantity, included pieces, packaging, and relative scale should remain accurate.

cards.title: Added graphics
body: Text, badges, borders, watermarks, promotional graphics, and extra logos do not belong on standard main images.

cards.title: Props and accessories
body: Extra objects can easily suggest that something else is included. Only relevant items that are part of the offer should appear.

cards.title: Image quality
body: Edges, texture, color, focus, and small product details should remain clear at both search and detail-page size.

cards.title: Resolution
body: Images at 1,000 pixels or above on the longest side can support zoom.

cards.title: Category rules
